snippet.title: Synth Riders Challenges+ Update Trailer | Meta Quest + PSVR2 + SteamVR
snippet.description:
Join the party @ https://bit.ly/playsr

Space invaders are entering Synth Riders to trip up your high score run. Maybe the on-screen notes will vanish. Or change colors. The dev team dares players on Meta Quest 2 and 3, SteamVR, and PlayStation VR2 to take on the latest free feature — Challenges+. Just update Synth Riders, it’s available now.
